title: Southern Splendor Pet‑Friendly 3‑Bedroom Seaside Home
meta_description: Settle into Southern Splendor, a pet‑friendly 3‑bedroom Seaside vacation home with multiple porches, a tower room, and an easy walk to the beach. Plan your Seaside stay today.
description_expanded: 751 FOREST STREETPET FRIENDLY UP TO 12 LBS.A Beloved Seaside Retreat Steps from the BeachSouthern Splendor is a cherished, family-favorite Seaside vacation home that has been recently renovated and thoughtfully refreshed for modern coastal living. Ideally located just a three-minute walk from the beach, this inviting residence blends classic Seaside charm with updated interiors and multiple outdoor living spaces. A cheerful pink front door sets the tone, welcoming guests onto a spacious front porch complete with outdoor dining, a picnic table, Adirondack seating for two, and views of a private side yard with a charcoal grill—perfect for relaxed afternoons and casual evenings.Bright, Open Living with a Fully Renovated KitchenInside, the first floor offers an airy, open-concept layout designed for gathering. The living area features stylish new furnishings, including two designer sofas, two club chairs, and a centrally located flat-screen TV ideal for movie nights after a day at the beach. Adjacent is a dining space with a large table for six, highlighted by a beautiful statement chandelier.The fully renovated kitchen is both functional and elegant, showcasing quartz countertops, a farmhouse sink, premium appliances, and a five-burner Dacor gas range. A large central island with seating for four and abundant built-in storage makes this kitchen perfect for preparing family meals or entertaining with ease.Tucked toward the rear of the home is the first bedroom, featuring a built-in queen bed, custom storage, a small closet, and convenient access to a shared full bathroom with a single vanity and glass-enclosed walk-in shower.Second-Floor Suites, Media Space, and Screened Porch LivingThe second floor expands the home’s comfort with two king bedrooms and a thoughtfully designed built-in twin bunk nook. The king primary suite includes a dresser, charming bay window, and a private ensuite bathroom with a single vanity and a newly updated deep soaker tub and shower. This serene retreat opens onto a screened porch with a cozy bench swing, offering a peaceful spot to enjoy evening breezes and quiet moments.The third bedroom is another spacious king that shares a fully renovated bathroom featuring a single vanity and deep soaker tub/shower combination. A central media area with a sofa, flat-screen TV, and HDMI access for gaming creates the perfect hangout space for kids or teens. An additional built-in twin bunk nook with integrated lighting and storage adds flexibility for extra guests.Outdoor living continues on this level with a large open-air furnished porch, complete with a swing chair and Adirondack seating.Tower Room with Views of Seaside and the GulfThe third floor reveals a charming bonus tower room featuring two twin beds and blackout curtains for restful nights. Just outside, an open-air balcony offers sweeping views across Seaside with glimpses of the Gulf beyond. This elevated perch is ideal for sunrise coffee, sunset watching, or simply soaking in the beauty of the town from above.A Pet-Friendly Home Designed for Relaxation and Return VisitsPet-friendly and filled with thoughtful amenities, Southern Splendor delivers exceptional comfort, multiple outdoor living areas, and a relaxed coastal atmosphere that guests love. With its ideal location, wide-open views, and welcoming design, this Seaside vacation home continues to be a favorite for families returning year after year. *5-night minimum Spring, Spring Break and Summer; 3-night minimum Fall; 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.* Pets are allowed with certain restrictions and provisions, only up to 12 pounds. An additional $100 per day rental pet fee will be collected, in addition to the flat $175 pet fee, for four-bedroom homes. Pets will not be allowed on furniture.FEATURES2,060 square feet3-minute, 176-yard walk to beach access at Pensacola Pavilion; Seaside is home to the largest residential private beaches on 30AOutdoor charcoal grillOutdoor showerWasher & dryerPeacock Alley Linens — Fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis & 3 pickle ball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities provided2 parking passes for two-bedroom and larger homes are issued. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permit.Pet-friendly — dogs under 12 pounds onlySTR23-001883
